text: Sandel had come from New Zealand. <break time="0.8s" /> With a fine record. <break time="0.8s" /> And for him. <break time="0.8s" /> A young man with everything to gain. <break time="0.8s" /> Tom was only a step upward. <break time="0.8s" /> Youth was the Nemesis. <break time="0.8s" /> Tom thought. <break time="0.8s" /> For it destroyed the old fighters one by one. <break time="0.8s" /> And, in doing so. <break time="0.8s" /> Slowly destroyed itself as well. <break time="0.8s" /> At the hall. <break time="0.8s" /> The secretary asked how he felt. <break time="0.8s" /> And Tom answered, Fit as a fiddle. <break time="0.8s" /> Though he would have given anything. <break time="0.8s" /> For a piece of steak. <break time="0.8s" /> When he climbed into the ring. <break time="0.8s" /> The crowd cheered. <break time="0.8s" /> Though most of the faces were strange to him. <break time="0.8s" /> The faces of a younger generation. <break time="0.8s" /> Then Sandel stepped through the ropes. <break time="0.8s" /> A young man with a curly mop of yellow hair. <break time="0.8s" /> And muscles that seemed to slide. <break time="0.8s" /> Like living things. <break time="0.8s" /> From the first bell. <break time="0.8s" /> Sandel rushed at him. <break time="0.8s" /> With all the fire of youth. <break time="0.8s" /> But Tom merely covered himself. <break time="0.8s" /> And did not strike back once. <break time="0.8s" /> Sandel must first foam away. <break time="0.8s" /> The froth of his youth. <break time="0.8s" /> Tom knew. <break time="0.8s" /> And until then. <break time="0.8s" /> The old man had to save. <break time="0.8s" /> Every ounce of strength. <break time="0.8s" /> He always ended a round in his own corner. <break time="0.8s" /> So that he could sit down at once. <break time="0.8s" /> While the crowd shouted. <break time="0.8s" /> Why do you not fight, Tom.
